item.title: About Me
item.description:
👋

A Research-focused engineer with experience in machine learning-based anomaly detection and time series analysis. PhD graduate from Nanjing University of Science and Technology, China, with recent experience at DESY, Germany. Developed methods to address challenges related to unknown attack detection in the field of cybersecurity and fault diagnosis for complex systems in the context of particle accelerators. Built practical expertise in research, development, and analytical problem-solving. Interested in having more theoretical and production contributions in the above topics, and remain open and curious to explore other data science and artificial intelligence applications.

Work Experience

Postdoctoral Postdoctoral Research Scientist · DESY
10/2022 – 10/2025
Machine Learning for Quench Detection in Superconducting RF Cavities
Developed machine-learning and neural-network solutions for quench detection at the European XFEL, including Neural Architecture Search models achieving a 70% reduction in model size. Worked on model optimization, online deployment, data labeling, and active-learning workflows.
Machine Learning Neural Architecture Search Anomaly Detection SRF Cavities European XFEL Active Learning
PhD Doctoral Researcher · Nanjing University of Science and Technology
09/2017 – 05/2022
Machine Learning for Anomaly Detection and Cybersecurity
Conducted research on unknown anomaly and attack detection using supervised and unsupervised machine learning, with a focus on active and continual learning. Collaborated internationally and contributed to interdisciplinary research in image watermarking and NLP.
Anomaly Detection Cybersecurity Machine Learning Active Learning Continual Learning IoT

Fostered scientific discussions and research collaboration around the PhD thesis and the topic of anomaly detection, exchanging ideas and exploring approaches with researchers at CNAM.

Led the development of a geolocation embedded system based on the SIM908 module and AT91SAM7S256 microcontroller, including low-level implementation using ARM Assembly Language.

Research focused on improving the detection of unknown attacks using machine learning methods. Completed research-related coursework and proposal development, alongside Chinese language and academic preparation.

Specialized in networks, embedded systems, and mobility. Master's thesis focused on the conception and development of a GSM/GPS-based anti-theft system for vehicles.
Computer Engineering Networks Embedded Systems GSM/GPS Mobility
